# OpenCaptions documentation

> OpenCaptions is free, open-source software (AGPL-3.0) that adds animated, word-by-word captions to videos. It transcribes speech with a model you choose (Whisper, Parakeet or Apple Speech), on an iPhone, iPad or Mac, on your computer from an agent or the command line, or on your own server with Docker, lets you style and correct every caption, and exports a captioned video or subtitle files. These are its docs.

## Start

- [Introduction](https://docs.opencaptions.app/): what it is and the two ways to use it
- [Quick start](https://docs.opencaptions.app/getting-started/quick-start/): run it with one Docker Compose file and one command
- [Your first captions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/getting-started/your-first-captions/): a walk through the web editor

## Guides

- [Transcription](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/transcription/): where audio is processed, the speech models, the languages
- [Editing captions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/editing/): fix words, retime on the timeline, undo
- [Bold word-by-word captions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/use-cases/bold-word-by-word-captions/): the short-form caption style, free and open source
- [A self-hosted alternative to caption subscriptions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/use-cases/self-hosted-alternative/): an honest comparison with hosted tools
- [Self-hosted Whisper captions with Docker](https://docs.opencaptions.app/use-cases/self-hosted-whisper-captions/): run the speech models on your own machine
- [Green screen captions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/use-cases/green-screen-captions/): a caption layer for your video editor
- [Styling captions](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/styling/): the nineteen looks and every style setting
- [Exporting](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/exporting/): MP4, WebM, ProRes, SRT, VTT, JSON and a green screen
- [The iPhone and iPad app](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/iphone-app/): on-device transcription, no account
- [From Claude and other agents](https://docs.opencaptions.app/guides/agents/): an MCP server and a command line (`npx opencaptions`) that caption a video on your computer, with no server
